changelog: Sekiro VR Native Color Fidelity & Gamma Fix v0.2.0
features: Native Color Fidelity: Eliminated double-gamma pow(2.2) crush in VR reprojection shaders
Restored Daylight & Atmosphere: Foliage, sky, temples, and background scenery render with 100% monitor-accurate brightness and lighting
Dev-Mode Precedence: Launcher prioritizes local build outputs over stale OTA cache during development
Custom Game Profile Mapping: Seamless profile binding for custom executables (e.g. sekiro.exe -> 814380_sekiro.json)
fixes: Fixed Sekiro and DX11 titles appearing pitch black in VR headset while daylight on monitor
Fixed shadow and midtone crushing where background trees and buildings were completely dark
Fixed launcher injectionManager overwriting fresh DLLs with stale OTA update cache
Fixed ENOENT error when searching for native build output in development mode
